Classes.Name: Fire alarm panel
Classes.Definition: A fire alarm control panel (FACP), also known as a fire alarm control unit (FACU), fire indicator panel (FIP), or simply a fire alarm panel, serves as the central command hub of a fire alarm system.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcAlarm.

Classes.Name: Home fire alarm device
Classes.Definition: A Home Fire Alarm Device (HFAD) is an automatic smoke or heat detector designed to provide early warning of a fire by sounding an alarm and alerting the occupants.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcAlarm.

Classes.Name: Manual alarm call point
Classes.Definition: An Manual Call Point is essentially a small box mounted on a wall. It contains a button or lever that allows you to manually trigger the fire alarm.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcAlarm.

Classes.Name: Sounder
Classes.Definition: A fire alarm sounder is an essential safety device designed to alert occupants of a building in the event of a fire or other emergency. Its primary function is to produce a loud sound to warn people to evacuate the building. It can be bell, horn, siren, etc.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcAlarm.

Classes.Name: Visual alarm
Classes.Definition: A visual alarm is a safety device designed to provide visual alerts during emergencies. Unlike traditional audible alarms that rely on sound, visual alarms use flashing lights to convey critical information. It can be flashing strobes, LED lights, or illuminated signs.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcAlarm.

Classes.Name: Site boundary
Classes.Definition: Boundary of a construction site.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcAnnotation.

Classes.Definition: Properties related to glazing.

Classes.Name: Household shelter
Classes.Definition: A household shelter is a designated space within residential buildings that serves as a protective refuge during emergencies.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcBuiltSystem.

Classes.Name: Precast external wall with castin windows
Classes.Definition: Precast external wall with preinstalled windows.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcBuiltSystem.

Classes.Name: Prefabricated and prefinished ceiling
Classes.Definition: Prefabricated ceiling with the complete finishings.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcBuiltSystem.

Classes.Name: Prefabricated and prefinished floor
Classes.Definition: Prefabricated floor with the complete finishings.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcBuiltSystem.

Classes.Name: Prefabricated and prefinished wall
Classes.Definition: Prefabricated wall with the complete finishings.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcBuiltSystem.

Classes.Name: Prefabricated bathroom unit
Classes.Definition: Prefabricated complete bathroom unit with the complete finishings.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcBuiltSystem.

Classes.Name: Prefabricated mep horizontal module
Classes.Definition: Prefabricated MEP module for horizontal installation.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcBuiltSystem.

Classes.Name: Prefabricated mep plant module
Classes.Definition: Prefabricated MEP Plant module.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcBuiltSystem.

Classes.Name: Prefabricated mep vertical module
Classes.Definition: Prefabricated MEP module for vertical installation.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcBuiltSystem.

Classes.Name: Prefabricated pump skid
Classes.Definition: A pump skid features a pump as its main component and is housed on a steel frame along with all the necessary components to run the pump that is prefabricated.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcBuiltSystem.

Classes.Name: Waste management
Classes.Definition: A vertical shaft to facilitate waste disposal for occupants living in tall buildings.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcBuiltSystem.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Burner Type Common
Classes.Definition: Common attributes of burner types.

Classes.Name: Fireplace
Classes.Definition: A fireplace, which can be in the apartment, on the terrace or in the yard. The energy source is set by PsetBurnerCommon.EnergySource.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcBurner.

Classes.Name: Fuel burning equipment
Classes.Definition: Fuel burning equipment is a general type of equipment that can be used to burn any fuel for any purpose.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcBurner.

Classes.Name: Incinerator
Classes.Definition: An incinerator is a device designed for burning waste material, especially industrial waste, at high temperatures until it is reduced to ash.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcBurner.

Classes.Name: Air
Classes.Definition: Replacement air for ventilation.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcChimney.

Classes.Name: Flue
Classes.Definition: Flue gases from fireplaces and heating appliances.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcChimney.

Classes.Name: Gas
Classes.Definition: Gas flues e.g. in petrochemical plants and destrict heating devices.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcChimney.

Classes.Name: Fire curtain
Classes.Definition: An incinerator is a device designed for burning waste material, especially industrial waste, at high temperatures until it is reduced to ash.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcCovering.

Classes.Name: Pipe sleeve
Classes.Definition: A pipe sleeve is a protective cover for the original pipe.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcCovering.

Classes.Name: PWCS inspection chamber cover
Classes.Definition: Pneumatic Waste Control (PWC) which utilizes a network of underground pipes to transport waste from various collection points to a central location, where it is then processed or disposed of. It uses penumatic suction mechanism.The system requires inspection chamber at certain interval, which must be provided with cover that either easily removable, or provide window for easy inspection.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcCovering.

Classes.Name: PWCS manhole cover
Classes.Definition: Pneumatic Waste Control manhole cover.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcCovering.

Classes.Name: Soffit
Classes.Definition: Soffit refers to the exposed siding located underneath the overhanging section of a roof.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcCovering.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Curtain Wall
Classes.Definition: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcCurtainWall.

Classes.Name: Facade system
Classes.Definition: Lightweight facade construction of glass or other panels.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcCurtainWall.

Classes.Name: Glazing system
Classes.Definition: Glazing system for example to balconies or terasses.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcCurtainWall.

Classes.Name: Partition system
Classes.Definition: Glass partition wall system.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcCurtainWall.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Damper
Classes.Definition: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcDamper.

Classes.Name: Grating
Classes.Definition: A grating can be a framework of parallel or crossed bars or wires, often used as a cover or screen, For example, a metal grating might be used as a walkway over a drainage channel or as a protective cover for machinery.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDiscreteAccessory.

Classes.Name: Pipe support
Classes.Definition: Pipe supporting elements typically used to support pipe and prevent pipe stresses and eliminate leakages at joints.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDiscreteAccessory.

Classes.Name: PWCS inspection chamber
Classes.Definition: Pneumatic Waste Control inspection chamber.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDistributionChamberElement.

Classes.Name: PWCS manhole
Classes.Definition: Pneumatic Waste Control manhole.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDistributionChamberElement.

Classes.Name: Sampling sump
Classes.Definition: A sampling sump is a designated location where samples are collected for analysis or monitoring purposes. It is commonly used in various contexts, such as environmental monitoring, industrial processes, and wastewater management.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDistributionChamberElement.

Classes.Name: Screen chamber
Classes.Definition: a screen chamber is designed to capture and retain larger solids present in the influent wastewater. Its primary purpose is to prevent these solids from entering downstream processes.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDistributionChamberElement.

Classes.Name: Drainage
Classes.Definition: Drainage is the natural or artificial removal of surface and underground water from an area where there is too much water.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDistributionSystem.

Classes.Name: Dry riser
Classes.Definition: A dry riser is a vertical pipe system installed in high-rise buildings to provide firefighters with access to water during emergencies, which is not filled with water except during emergency when the riser is connected to the water source through its breeching inlet.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDistributionSystem.

Classes.Name: Foam fire extinguishing
Classes.Definition: A foam fire extinguisher is a type of fire safety equipment that contains a special foam mixture designed to extinguish fires.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDistributionSystem.

Classes.Name: Foam sprinkler
Classes.Definition: A foam sprinkler system is a specialized fire suppression solution designed to combat high-risk fire hazards, particularly those involving flammable liquids or materials using a mixture of water and a low expansion foam concentrate.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDistributionSystem.

Classes.Name: Potable water
Classes.Definition: A distribution system for drinkable water.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDistributionSystem.

Classes.Name: Smoke control
Classes.Definition: A smoke control system is an engineered system designed to modify the movement of smoke during a fire incident. Its primary purpose is to protect building occupants, firefighters, and property.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDistributionSystem.

Classes.Name: Smoke purging
Classes.Definition: A smoke purging system is designed to extract smoke from indoor areas after a fire has been extinguished. Unlike active fire control systems, it doesn’t fight the fire directly. Instead, its purpose is to quickly clear smoke, which can be as dangerous as the fire itself.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDistributionSystem.

Classes.Name: Smoke vent
Classes.Definition: A vent that is installed to release smoke, heat, and hot gases from a burning building.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDistributionSystem.

Classes.Name: Sprinkler
Classes.Definition: Fire protection sprinkler system.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDistributionSystem. Replace FIREPROTECTION with this type.

Classes.Name: Wet riser
Classes.Definition: A wet riser is a vertical pipe system installed in high-rise buildings to provide firefighters with access to water during emergencies. Wet riser is always  filled with water and connected to a pump.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDistributionSystem.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Door Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Regulatory properties of doors.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Door Common
Classes.Definition: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcDoor.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Door Locking Properties
Classes.Definition: Door locking properties of a door.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Door Operating Properties
Classes.Definition: Door operating properties of a door.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Door Panel Properties
Classes.Definition: Door panel properties.

Classes.Name: Access hatch
Classes.Definition: An access hatch is a special type of access panel that is generally used for entry into larger spaces, often in industrial settings. These hatches are commonly found in roofs or floors, providing access to significant areas such as crawl spaces, attics, or even underground areas.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDoor.

Classes.Name: Blast door
Classes.Definition: A blast door is a heavy-duty, reinforced door designed to withstand powerful forces such as explosions, impacts, or extreme pressure changes. It is usually required as part of bomb shelter.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDoor.

Classes.Name: Roller shutter
Classes.Definition: Roller shutters made from fire-resistant materials, such as steel or aluminum, can help prevent the spread of fire and typically is equipped with automatic closure system that will be activated in case of fire, separating an area from other compartment.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDoor.

Classes.Name: Waste hatch
Classes.Definition: A hatch through which waste is placed in the waste chute.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcDoor.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Duct Segment Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Duct segment properties for the regulatory process.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Facility Summary
Classes.Definition: Summary properties of facilities.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Fan Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Fans in the regulatory process.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Fire Suppression Terminal Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Regulatory properties of fire suppression terminals.

Classes.Name: Foam inlet
Classes.Definition: A foam inlet is a type of a breeching on the outside of a building, which is used by the Fire Service to pump foam into foam spreaders inside the building.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFireSuppressionTerminal.

Classes.Name: Foam outlet
Classes.Definition: A foam outlet is an outlet designed to discharge foam that is typically used in the spaces that contains combustible materials.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFireSuppressionTerminal.

Classes.Name: Standby firehose
Classes.Definition: A standby fire hose is designed to deliver water or fire-retardant foam to extinguish fires. It provides a reliable water supply when needed.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFireSuppressionTerminal.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Flow Meter Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Regulatory properties of flow meters.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Furnishing Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Regulatory properties of furnishing elements.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Furniture Type Common
Classes.Definition: Common properties for all types of furniture such as chair, desk, table, and file cabinet.

Classes.Name: Bicycle rack
Classes.Definition: A rack for bicycle parking.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Portable fire extinguisher
Classes.Definition: Portable type fire extinguisher.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Counter
Classes.Definition: Counter is a type of desk typically facilitates interaction between public and a service agent.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Bench
Classes.Definition: Bench
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Cleaning cabinet
Classes.Definition: A cupboard dedicated to cleaning equipment.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Cabinet
Classes.Definition: Closet to storage anything including clothes.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Handicap accessory
Classes.Definition: Various types of fixed handholds, handrails and other assistive devices required in accessible spaces
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Kitchen cabinet
Classes.Definition: Built-in or free-standing kitchen cabinets that are not intended to be moved.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Notice board
Classes.Definition: A notice board, which may contain, for example, information about the apartments in the building or on which notices may be posted.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Shower screen
Classes.Definition: A permanently installed screen that protects the washroom area from spray from the shower.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Changing bed
Classes.Definition: The changing bed is a solution for people with reduced mobility who need assistance with changing clothes or personal hygiene.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Child protection seat
Classes.Definition: A special seat with protection feature for young child specifically located in a family fiendly public spaces especially in the washrooms or toilet areas.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Cubicle
Classes.Definition: A cubicle is a small, partially enclosed office workspace that is separated from adjacent workspaces by partitions or panels.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Diaper changing table
Classes.Definition: A special table that is designed for parent to change the baby's diaper.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Planter box
Classes.Definition: A planter box is a container designed for growing plants, flowers, or herbs.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Recyclable compactor
Classes.Definition: Compactor dedicated for recycleable materials.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Recyclable container
Classes.Definition: Container dedicated for recycleable materials.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Waste bin
Classes.Definition: A waste bin is a container used for the temporary storage of waste.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: WASTECOMPACTOR
Classes.Definition: A waste compactor is a machine or device designed to reduce waste by compacting it into a smaller, more manageable size.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Waste container
Classes.Definition: A waste container is a receptacle used for the temporary storage of waste materials.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcFurniture.

Classes.Name: Cadastral lot
Classes.Definition: A cadastral lot, also known as a parcel, plot, or land lot, is a defined piece of land within a cadastral system.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcGeographicElement.

Classes.Name: Existing earthworks
Classes.Definition: Existing area with earthworks.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcGeographicElement.

Classes.Name: Green verge
Classes.Definition: A green verge refers to the portion along the center median or side of a public street, or a traffic island within a public street, which is provided for the growing of trees or plants.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcGeographicElement.

Classes.Name: Shrub
Classes.Definition: A shrub or landscape area dedicated to shrubs.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcGeographicElement.

Classes.Name: Tree
Classes.Definition: Tree or landscape area dedicated for tree planting.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcGeographicElement.

Classes.Name: Planting area
Classes.Definition: Landscape area dedicated for planting.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcGeographicElement.

Classes.Name: Pollution control equipment
Classes.Definition: Specialised equipment usually required in a factory environment to treat and remove industrial process by-products that may release toxic substances. It can be applied to the treatment of air/gas, liquids and solid pollutants.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcInterceptor.

Classes.Name: Road kerb
Classes.Definition: Road kerb
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcKerb.

Classes.Name: Kerb
Classes.Definition: General kerb
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcKerb.

Classes.Name: Drive way
Classes.Definition: Vehicle driveway within a building site.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcPavement.

Classes.Name: Entrance culvert
Classes.Definition: An arched drain or conduit constructed at the access point to private lands.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcPavement.

Classes.Name: Footpath
Classes.Definition: Foot path
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcPavement.

Classes.Name: Drain channel bend
Classes.Definition: A bend in the drain channel.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcPipeFitting.

Classes.Name: Flange adaptor
Classes.Definition: An adaptor to join between dissimilar flange types or flanged and non-flanged equipment.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcPipeFitting.

Classes.Name: Flexible coupling
Classes.Definition: Flexible couplings are essential components that connect two shafts, allowing them to transmit torque while accommodating misalignment.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcPipeFitting.

Classes.Name: Pipe silencer
Classes.Definition: Silencer fitted to a pipe system to absorb sound, thus reducing noise.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcPipeFitting.

Classes.Name: Short piece
Classes.Definition: Short piece of pipe for installation.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcPipeFitting.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Pipe Segment Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Regulatory properties of pipe segments.

Classes.Name: Flare stack
Classes.Definition: A flare stack, also known as a flare boom, ground flare, or flare pit, is a gas combustion device used for burning off flammable gas released by safety valves during unplanned overpressuring of plant equipment in places like petroleum refineries, chemical plants, and natural gas processing plants.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcPipeSegment.

Classes.Name: Foundation
Classes.Definition: Bedding that is used to support underground sewer pipe.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcPipeSegment.

Classes.Name: Rainwater outlet
Classes.Definition: Outlet for the rainwater pipe/gutter.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcPipeSegment.

Classes.Name: Scupper drain
Classes.Definition: Scuppers are used to provide an outlet through parapet walls or gravel stops on flat and built-up roofs to allow drainage of excess water. They can be used in conjunction with gutters and downspouts to divert the flow to the desired location.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcPipeSegment.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Railing Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Regulatory properties of railings.

Classes.Name: Bollard
Classes.Definition: A bollard is a sturdy, short, vertical post installed to control road traffic and help delimit areas (such as traffic islands) or prevent vehicles from colliding with pedestrians and structures.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcRailing.

Classes.Name: Roof rail
Classes.Definition: Handrails on the roof of a building to prevent people or, for example, snow from falling from the roof.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcRailing.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Ramp Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Regulatory properties of ramps.

Classes.Name: Accessible route
Classes.Definition: A ramp that is part of the handicapped accessible route.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcRamp.

Classes.Name: Curved ramp
Classes.Definition: A curved ramp.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcRamp.

Classes.Name: Driveway
Classes.Definition: A ramp that is part of the vehicle driveway.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcRamp.

Classes.Name: Flared kerb ramp
Classes.Definition: A widened kerb ramp is a type of ramp that provides a smooth transition between the pavement and the street for pedestrians, including those using wheelchairs, pushchairs and bicycles.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcRamp.

Classes.Name: Air impurities sensor
Classes.Definition: An air impurities sensor is an air quality sensor designed to detect and measure the presence and concentration of various pollutants and contaminants in the air.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSensor.

Classes.Name: Louvred panel
Classes.Definition: A louvred panel is a flat surface that contains a series of angled slats or blades, known as louvres. These louvres are designed to allow air or light to pass through while providing protection from direct sunlight, rain, or other environmental elements.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcShadingDevice.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Sanitary Terminal Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Regulatory properties of sanitary terminals.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Sign Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Signs in the regulatory process.

Classes.Name: Signage exit
Classes.Definition: Exit signage indicating exit door in a building.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSign.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Address
Classes.Definition: This Property Set represents an address for delivery of paper based mail and other postal deliveries.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Land Registration
Classes.Definition: Specifies the identity of land within a statutory registration system.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Slab Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Regulatory properties of slabs.

Classes.Name: Service platform
Classes.Definition: A service platform can be, for example, a level on the roof of a building or in a technical area, providing access to service facilities.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSlab.

Classes.Name: Surface slab
Classes.Definition: The lightweight upper part of a slab structure, usually made of concrete. The surface slab structure is covered with a floor coating.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSlab.

Classes.Name: Accessible route
Classes.Definition: A slab that is walkable and form a part of the handicapped accessible route.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSlab.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Parking Bay Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Regulatory properties of parking bays.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Restroom Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Regulatory properties of restrooms.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Space Common
Classes.Definition: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcSpace.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Space Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Regulatory properties of spaces.

Classes.Name: Apartment
Classes.Definition: Space entity representin apartment  area.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpace.

Classes.Name: Level area
Classes.Definition: Level area (LA) is a measured area for one level, including all areas contained inside and measured to the outside permanent finished surface. This includes penthouses and mezzanines, basement and enclosed/covered connecting walkways and linkways. Total level area is a sum of level areas.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpace.

Classes.Name: Net floor area
Classes.Definition: Net floor area (NFA) is the measured area in one floor excluding external walls, load-bearing structures, openings, etc. The total net floor area is the sum of the net floor areas.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpace.

Classes.Name: Regulatory level area
Classes.Definition: The regulatory level area (RLA) is the area of a single storey measured in accordance with the national building code. The total regulatory level area is the sum of the regulatory level areas.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpace.

Classes.Name: Rentable area
Classes.Definition: The rentable area is the area of one room according to the rules for calculating the rentable area.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpace.

Classes.Name: Chase
Classes.Definition: A chase is a vertical space within a building structure that allows for the routing of utility services such as electrical wiring, plumbing pipes, and sometimes small HVAC ducts.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpace.

Classes.Name: Shaft
Classes.Definition: A shaft is a large vertical passage within a building that accommodates substantial building systems.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpace.

Classes.Name: Bicycle lot
Classes.Definition: An area reserved for the parking of bicycles.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpace.

Classes.Name: Bus lot
Classes.Definition: A parking lot specifically designated for buses.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpace.

Classes.Name: Car lot
Classes.Definition: A typical car parking lot.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpace.

Classes.Name: Coach lot
Classes.Definition: A parking lot specifically designated for coaches (typically privately run long distance buses).
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpace.

Classes.Name: Lorry lot
Classes.Definition: A parking lot designated for lorries.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpace.

Classes.Name: Motorcycle lot
Classes.Definition: A parking lot designated for motorcycles.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpace.

Classes.Name: Landscape
Classes.Definition: An area that represent landscape area.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpace.

Classes.Name: Waste chute
Classes.Definition: A waste chute is a vertical passageway in a building that allows residents or occupants to dispose of waste conveniently by dropping it into the chute. The chute then directs the waste to a centralised collection area, typically in the basement or a designated waste room.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpace.

Classes.Name: Washroom
Classes.Definition: A space for washroom or toilet.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpace.

Classes.Name: Accessible route
Classes.Definition: A model representation of handicapped accessible route. The main purpose is to identify the designed accessible route that can be visualized easily.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpatialZone.

Classes.Name: Access road
Classes.Definition: An area or space that represent access road.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpatialZone.

Classes.Name: Accessway
Classes.Definition: An area or space that represent accessway.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpatialZone.

Classes.Name: Fire engine accessway
Classes.Definition: Fire engine accessways is a vehicle access road within a development that is designed to ensure that firefighting vehicles can reach the building quickly during emergencies.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpatialZone.

Classes.Name: Fire engine lot
Classes.Definition: A dedicated location that meets the load requirements for parking the fire engine in the event of fire emergency.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpatialZone.

Classes.Name: Vehicular service road
Classes.Definition: A vehicular service road provides access to buildings, facilities or specific areas for service vehicles, delivery trucks and maintenance crews.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpatialZone.

Classes.Name: Escape route
Classes.Definition: An escape route is a designated route or series of routes along which occupants can safely exit a building in the event of an emergency, such as a fire, earthquake or other hazard.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpatialZone.

Classes.Name: Vehicle access
Classes.Definition: Vehicle access provides the ability for vehicles to enter, move within, and exit a particular area, property, or roadway.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcSpatialZone.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Stair Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Regulatory conditions of stairs.

Classes.Name: Balancing tank
Classes.Definition: A balancing tank balances or equalises the flow and concentration of water or wastewater entering the treatment process.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcTank.

Classes.Name: Detention tank
Classes.Definition: A detention tank, also known as a retention basin or reservoir, is a structure designed to manage stormwater by temporarily storing excess water and releasing it in a controlled manner.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcTank.

Classes.Name: Ejector tank
Classes.Definition: An ejector tank, also known as a wastewater ejector pump system or wastewater ejector tank, is a system used to control and transport wastewater from lower floors, such as basements or lower floors of a building, to upper floors where it can enter the main sewer line or septic system.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcTank.

Classes.Name: Irrigation tank
Classes.Definition: An irrigation tank is a water storage reservoir designed to collect and store water for agricultural irrigation purposes.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcTank.

Classes.Name: Potable water
Classes.Definition: A tank that contains drinkable water.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcTank.

Classes.Name: Rainwater harvesting tank
Classes.Definition: A special tank dedicated to collect rain water.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcTank.

Classes.Name: Recharge well
Classes.Definition: A recharge well, also known as a groundwater recharge well or infiltration well, is a structure designed to facilitate the process of recharging or replenishing groundwater aquifers.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcTank.

Classes.Name: Waste handling equipment
Classes.Definition: Waste handling equipment includes a variety of tools and machines used to handle, process, transport and dispose of waste.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcTank.

Classes.Name: Sectional
Classes.Definition: A water tank that consists of multiple sections.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcTank.

Classes.Name: Sprinkler tank
Classes.Definition: A water tank dedicated to supplying water for the sprinkler system.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcTank.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Lifting Platform Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Regulatory properties of lifting platforms.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Transport Element Elevator
Classes.Definition: Regulatory properties of elevators.

Classes.Name: Maintenance platform
Classes.Definition: A suspended platform used for facade maintenance and cleaning.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcTransportElement.

Classes.Name: Bin lifter
Classes.Definition: A bin lifter is a mechanical device designed to lift and empty waste bins or carts into larger waste containers, such as dumpsters or garbage trucks.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcTransportElement.

Classes.Name: Goods lift
Classes.Definition: A Lift or elevator dedicated for the movement of goods
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcTransportElement.

Classes.Name: Lifting platform
Classes.Definition: A lifting platform, also known as a scissor lift, aerial lift, or elevating work platform (EWP), is a mechanical device designed to lift people or materials to higher elevations.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcTransportElement.

Classes.Name: Platform lift
Classes.Definition: A platform lift, also known as a vertical platform lift (VPL), wheelchair lift, or accessibility lift, is a mechanical device designed to transport people and/or small loads vertically between different levels, such as building floors or the entrance and the ground.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcTransportElement.

Classes.Name: Automatic rescue device
Classes.Definition: An Automatic Rescue Device (ARD) is a safety system installed in elevators. When power outages or mechanical malfunctions occur, the ARD ensures passengers’ security. If an elevator gets stuck, the ARD moves it to the nearest floor and opens the doors, allowing safe exit.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcUnitaryControlElement.

Classes.Name: Lift supervisory panel
Classes.Definition: A lift supervisory panel typically consists of a control panel installed in a secure location within a building, often in a control room or maintenance area. It includes buttons, indicators, and a display screen for monitoring and controlling multiple elevators in the building.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcUnitaryControlElement.

Classes.Name: Property Set: Wall Regulatory
Classes.Definition: Regulatory properties of walls.

Classes.Name: Landing valve
Classes.Definition: The landing valve serves as a manual stop valve that allows complete control over the firefighting system. When firefighters need to extinguish a fire, they turn the landing valve handle counterclockwise to activate the water flow. Landing valves are installed on risers within buildings, typically near staircase landings.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcValve.

Classes.Name: Reflux valve
Classes.Definition: A reflux valve, also known as a check valve or non-return valve, allows fluid (liquid or gas) to flow through it in only one direction.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcValve.

Classes.Name: Sprinkler control
Classes.Definition: A sprinkler control valve is a crucial component in fire protection systems. It’s part of a network that includes sensors, valves, and piping. The valve will activate when the metal strip melts or the liquid-filled glass bulb shatters, allowing the water to escape tfrom the pipe above.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcValve.

Classes.Name: Waste sump
Classes.Definition: A waste sump is designed to remove groundwater from basements, including any water collected from cavity drain membranes. It is typically located at the lowest point of a basement.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcWasteTerminal.

Classes.Name: Bay window
Classes.Definition: A bay window is a window space that projects outward from the main walls of a building, creating a bay within a room. It typically consists of a central fixed sash window flanked by two or more smaller casement or double-hung windows.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcWindow.

Classes.Name: Ventilation sleeve
Classes.Definition: A special type of ventilation device typically installed in a household shelter. It is designed to provide an air-tight shelter during an emergency.
Classes.Description: This is a subclass (PredefinedType) of IfcWindow.

Properties.Definition: The primary alphanumeric identifier of the premises.

Properties.Name: Purpose
Properties.Definition: The purpose describes the type of premises such as residential, commercial, office, healthcare and industrial.

Properties.Name: SectionCode
Properties.Definition: Identifier of the section, block or staircase where the premises is located.

Properties.Name: SuffixCode
Properties.Definition: A sub-identifier specifying the premises.

Properties.Name: Equipment
Properties.Definition: List of equipment on the premises.

Properties.Name: HasBalcony
Properties.Definition: The premises have balconies (one or more).

Properties.Name: HasCookingFacilities
Properties.Definition: The premises have a kitchen or other space for cooking (one or more).

Properties.Name: HasHotWater
Properties.Definition: Hot water is available on the premises.

Properties.Name: HasTerrace
Properties.Definition: The premises have terraces (one or more).

Properties.Name: HasToilet
Properties.Definition: There are toilets (one or more) on the premises.

Properties.Name: HasWashroom
Properties.Definition: There are washrooms (one or more) on the premises.

Properties.Name: RoomCount
Properties.Definition: Number of rooms in the premises.

Properties.Name: TypeOfCookingFacility
Properties.Definition: Nature of the cooking facility (e.g. separate room, part of a another room).

Properties.Name: ApplicationArea
Properties.Definition: The area of the part of the building affected by the application.

Properties.Name: ApplicationDate
Properties.Definition: The date on which the application was submitted to the authority.

Properties.Name: ConstructionActivityType
Properties.Definition: Type of construction activity.

Properties.Name: ConstructionExecutionType
Properties.Definition: Execution type information describes how the construction work is organised (e.g. by a contractor, by a public organisation, self-built).

Properties.Name: DesignDiscipline
Properties.Definition: The design discipline to which the model belongs.

Properties.Name: DesignOffice
Properties.Definition: The design firm responsible for the design of this model.

Properties.Name: IsBeingConstructed
Properties.Definition: The facility is under construction.

Properties.Name: IsTemporary
Properties.Definition: The object of the application is a temporary structure.

Properties.Name: LeadDesigner
Properties.Definition: The lead designer of the project.

Properties.Name: RegulatoryActivityType
Properties.Definition: Type of regulatory activity. The types of activities are defined nationally and may relate to, for example, demolition of existing structures, the start of construction work, the occupation of a facility or a change of use of a facility.

Properties.Name: RegulatoryStage
Properties.Definition: Regulatory stage of the application (Concept Approval, Technical Approval, Approval to Occupy etc.)

Properties.Name: ResponsibleDesigner
Properties.Definition: The designer responsible for the design discipline of this model.

Properties.Name: CombustionLoadAreal
Properties.Definition: Combustion load of the object presented according to national building regulation.

Properties.Name: CombustionLoadTotal
Properties.Definition: Combustion load of the object presented according to national building regulation.

Properties.Name: CombustionLoadVolumetric
Properties.Definition: Combustion load per area of the object presented according to national building regulation.

Properties.Name: OccupancyCapacity
Properties.Definition: Maximum number of occupants of the object.

Properties.Name: OccupancyTypeName
Properties.Definition: Occupancy type name for this object. It is defined according to the presiding national building code.

Properties.Name: AxleLoading
Properties.Definition: Maximum axle loading.

Properties.Name: IsFireFightIngVehicleAccess
Properties.Definition: Is for firefighting vehicle access.

Properties.Name: LoadCapacity
Properties.Definition: Ground loading capacity.

Properties.Name: RoadWidthBetweenKerbs
Properties.Definition: Width of road between kerbs.

Properties.Name: HasCentralHandrails
Properties.Definition: Is provided with a central handrail.

Properties.Name: IsFireFightingStair
Properties.Definition: Is a fire-fighting stair.

Properties.Name: IsProtectedFromBadWeather
Properties.Definition: Is protected from the effects of bad weather.

Properties.Name: RiseIsOpen
Properties.Definition: Rise is open.

Properties.Name: HasHandrail
Properties.Definition: Handrail is provided.

Properties.Name: LandingCallControlsHeight
Properties.Definition: Height of landing call buttons above landing.

Properties.Name: IsEvacuationLift
Properties.Definition: Is an evacuation lift.

Properties.Name: HasCavityBarriers
Properties.Definition: Cavity barrier is provided.

Properties.Name: HasCavityFirestopping
Properties.Definition: Has cavity firestopping.

Properties.Name: IsCommonToTwoOrMoreBuildings
Properties.Definition: Is common to two or more buildings.

Properties.Name: ExternalFinish
Properties.Definition: Exterior window finish.

Properties.Name: InteriorFinish
Properties.Definition: Window interior finish.

Properties.Name: SillInformation
Properties.Definition: Window sill information.

Properties.Name: WindowControlsHeight
Properties.Definition: Height of window controls above floor level.

Properties.Name: HandleSpecification
Properties.Definition: Window handle information.

Properties.Name: HasControlsOperableWithOneHand
Properties.Definition: Window controls are operable without using both hands simultaneously.

Properties.Name: FirefightingAccess
Properties.Definition: Object is part of firefighting route.

Properties.Name: IsTempered
Properties.Definition: The glass parts of the object are tempered.

Properties.Name: IsLaminated
Properties.Definition: The glass parts of the object are laminated.

Properties.Name: IsWired
Properties.Definition: The glass parts of the object are wired.

Properties.Name: IsLaminatedInside
Properties.Definition: Inner glass of the object is laminated.

Properties.Name: IsLaminatedOutside
Properties.Definition: Outer glass of the object is laminated.

Properties.Name: IsTemperedInside
Properties.Definition: Inner glass of the object is tempered.

Properties.Name: IsTemperedOutside
Properties.Definition: Outer glass of the object is tempered.

Properties.Name: IsWiredInside
Properties.Definition: Inner glass of the object is wired.

Properties.Name: IsWiredOutside
Properties.Definition: Outer glass of the object is wired.

Properties.Name: HasAirInlet
Properties.Definition: The object has an integrated air inlet for ventilation.

Properties.Name: EntranceType
Properties.Definition: Type of entrance provided by the door.

Properties.Name: IsInterconnected
Properties.Definition: Seats connected to each other (e.g., in auditoriums).

Properties.Name: IsConversion
Properties.Definition: The entity is a conversion to existing situation.

Properties.Name: IsRemoved
Properties.Definition: The entity is removed. This information is used particularly in situations where the object to be removed is abstract, or where the object is not demolished but, for example, moved somewhere else.

Properties.Name: IsExisting
Properties.Definition: The object is the existing situation.

Properties.Name: BicyclePlaces
Properties.Definition: Number of bicycle parking spaces provided.

Properties.Name: HasWaterInsulatedFloor
Properties.Definition: The space has a water-insulated floor.

Properties.Name: HasWaterInsulatedWalls
Properties.Definition: The space has water-insulated walls.

Properties.Name: PushchairPlaces
Properties.Definition: Number of pram (pushchair) parking spaces.

Properties.Name: StorageUnits
Properties.Definition: Number of storage units (for apartment-specific use).

Properties.Name: IsHeated
Properties.Definition: The stair is heated.

Properties.Name: DoorOpeningWidth
Properties.Definition: Clear width of doorway.

Properties.Name: DoorOpeningHeight
Properties.Definition: Clear height of doorway.

Properties.Name: IsOpenable
Properties.Definition: The object is openable.

Properties.Name: FireAlarms
Properties.Definition: Principle for determining the number of fire alarms according to national building regulation.

Properties.Name: PreviousOccupancyType
Properties.Definition: Previous occupancy type for this object. It is defined according to the presiding national building code.
